run_load_experiment: run load_experiment on a predictions JSONL file to compute F1 scores aggregated by question type and database size
review_load_experiment: review load_experiment to understand how it bins database sizes and computes per-category F1 scores
refactor_load_experiment: refactor load_experiment to accept a db_sizes lookup dict as a parameter instead of relying on a global variable
summarize_main_block: summarize the main block that globs prediction files, builds a pivot table, and plots accuracy by database size
test_load_experiment: test load_experiment with a sample predictions JSONL file to verify F1 score aggregation by type and size
